title: Embetty Noctalia
widget.tooltip: Embetty Noctalia — sessions survive closing the panel
settings.shell.label: Shell
settings.shell.description: Shell executable: bash, zsh, fish, or an absolute path. A new shell is started for each session.
settings.startup_command.label: Startup command
settings.startup_command.description: Optional command to run after a new session is created. Leave empty to do nothing.
settings.scrollback_chars.label: Scrollback size (characters)
settings.scrollback_chars.description: How many recent output characters to keep and display. Older output is trimmed.
settings.max_sessions.label: Maximum sessions
settings.max_sessions.description: How many named sessions can exist at the same time.
settings.block_destructive.label: Block destructive commands
settings.block_destructive.description: Heuristic guard against rm -rf /, disk formatting, and similar commands. This is not a sandbox.
settings.font_family.label: Font family
settings.font_family.description: Monospace font family used for output and the command field.
settings.font_size.label: Font size
settings.font_size.description: Terminal text size in logical pixels.
settings.glyph.label: Widget glyph
settings.glyph.description: Tabler/Nerd Font glyph used by the bar widget.
settings.show_label.label: Show label
settings.show_label.description: Show the plugin name next to the bar icon.
panel.delete_warning: Processes in this session will be terminated and its history deleted.
panel.empty: Type a command below. This is not a full terminal emulator: full-screen TUI apps are not supported.
panel.password_hint: Password input is hidden because the terminal does not echo it. Press Enter to send it.
panel.password_not_waiting: The session is no longer waiting for a password.
panel.password_shell: Refusing to send raw input to a shell; nothing was executed.
panel.hint: Enter runs a command · Ctrl+C, Tab, and Esc are sent to the PTY with the buttons on the right
panel.state_sleeping: sleeping — resumes on the next command
panel.name_invalid: Name must be 1–40 characters with no / or \
